employees.label: Employees
employees.definition: Approximate number of Uber employees located outside the United States (10-K).

courierEarnings.label: Courier earnings on Uber Eats
courierEarnings.definition: What U.S. couriers made on the Uber Eats platform in 2024, as stated in the Uber Eats U.S. Merchant Impact Report produced with Public First.

eatsNewRevenue.label: Estimated new revenue from Uber Eats
eatsNewRevenue.definition: Public First estimate of new revenue for the U.S. economy driven by Uber Eats orders that would not have occurred otherwise.

econValueCAD.label: Estimated economic value supported by Uber
econValueCAD.definition: Public First estimate commissioned by Uber of the economic value or activity Uber supports in the country, as Uber's local newsroom reports it. Total economic value for Canada; the en-CA page states '$', read as Canadian dollars.

econValueNZD.label: Estimated economic value supported by Uber
econValueNZD.definition: Public First estimate commissioned by Uber of the economic value or activity Uber supports in the country, as Uber's local newsroom reports it. Direct, indirect and induced value of Uber and Uber Eats; the en-NZ page states '$', read as New Zealand dollars.

econValueBDT.label: Estimated economic value supported by Uber
econValueBDT.definition: Public First estimate commissioned by Uber of the economic value or activity Uber supports in the country, as Uber's local newsroom reports it. Economic activity across Bangladesh.

econValueLKR.label: Estimated economic value supported by Uber
econValueLKR.period: 2024 (Sri Lanka Economic Impact Report; post dated Dec 12, 2025)
econValueLKR.definition: Public First estimate commissioned by Uber of the economic value or activity Uber supports in the country, as Uber's local newsroom reports it. Economic value generated by Uber and Uber Eats 'within a single year'; reported as 'more than'.

econValueTWD.label: Estimated economic value supported by Uber
econValueTWD.definition: Public First estimate commissioned by Uber of the economic value or activity Uber supports in the country, as Uber's local newsroom reports it. Uber Eats only: direct, indirect and induced economic value for delivery people, restaurants and other businesses.

econValueGBP.label: Estimated economic value supported by Uber
econValueGBP.definition: Public First estimate commissioned by Uber of the economic value or activity Uber supports in the country, as Uber's local newsroom reports it. Economic value unlocked for the UK; the latest UK edition found, older than the snapshot year.

source.label: Uber Eats U.S. Merchant Impact Report (2025), modelling by Public First for Uber Eats
source.quote: driving an estimated $9.4 billion in new revenue for the United States economy that wouldn’t have occurred otherwise. … In 2024, U.S. couriers made $1.3 billion on the Uber Eats platform.

source.label: Uber Canada newsroom: Driving Growth, Fuelling Opportunity: Uber’s $13.6B Boost to Canada’s Economy in 2024 (Public First)
source.quote: Uber’s latest Economic Impact Report reveals that the platform helped generate an estimated $13.6 billion in total economic value for Canada last year

source.label: Uber New Zealand newsroom: Uber’s impact in 2024: contributing $1.5 billion to New Zealand’s economy (Public First)
source.quote: Uber contributed an estimated $1.5 billion into New Zealand’s economy in 2024

source.label: Uber Bangladesh newsroom: 2024 Economic Impact Report compiled by Public First
source.quote: In 2024, Uber helped drive an estimated BDT 55 billion in economic activity across the country

source.label: Uber Sri Lanka newsroom, Dec 12, 2025: A Decade of Moving Sri Lanka Forward (Public First 2024 report)
source.quote: According to the 2024 Sri Lanka Economic Impact Report by global research firm Public First, Uber and Uber Eats generated more than LKR 160 billion in economic value within a single year.

source.label: Uber Taiwan newsroom, Oct 29, 2024: Uber Eats Fuels Economic Growth in Taiwan (Public First)
source.quote: in the year ending September 2024, Uber Eats created an impressive NTD 86 billion in direct, indirect, and induced economic value for delivery people, restaurants and other businesses.

source.label: Uber UK newsroom, Sep 20, 2023: The Impact of Uber in the UK (Public First)
source.quote: The impact of this activity meant that Uber unlocked an estimated £5 billion in economic value for the UK last year

source.label: Uber Technologies Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, Item 1A Risk Factors
source.quote: As of December 31, 2025, we had approximately 34,000 global employees, of whom approximately 20,300 were located outside the United States.

sites.name: Corporate headquarters
sites.description: 1.8 million square feet for the corporate headquarters, within 9.3 million sq ft of leased and owned offices worldwide

source.label: Uber Technologies Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, Item 2 Properties
source.quote: As of December 31, 2025, we leased and owned office facilities around the world totaling 9.3 million square feet, including 1.8 million square feet for our corporate headquarters in the San Francisco Bay Area, California.

notes: No U.S. state breakdown exists on uber.com. Checked 2026-11-24: Uber's sitemap index and the us_en, global_en, ca_en, nz_en, bd_en, gb_en, lk_en and zh-tw sitemaps for impact, economic and economy newsroom pages. The commissioned country reports are unchanged because no newer edition was found (checked 2026-11-24): Canada's newest is the 2024 report (older ones are 2022 and 2023, plus British Columbia 2023), New Zealand's is 2024, Bangladesh's is 2024 (older: 2021), Sri Lanka's is the 2024 report cited in the Dec 2025 post (older: 2021), Taiwan's is the year ending September 2024 (older: 2023), and the UK's newest is the Sep 2023 post about 2022. The U.S. Uber Eats figures come from the 2025 U.S. Merchant Impact Report (2024 data); no 2026 edition was found. State posts on the U.S. newsroom date from 2015-2018 or are advocacy pieces, and the U.S. 'Uber in the economy' page cites an undated EDR Group study, not used. Country rows are Public First estimates commissioned by Uber, each in its own currency, so they are separate metrics and not comparable. CA and NZ amounts appear only as '$' on the local pages and are read as local dollars. India's 'INR 36,000 crores' is a forecast for Auto and Moto only and was skipped. Employees: the FY2025 10-K gives ~34,000 global employees at Dec 31, 2025, of whom ~20,300 were outside the U.S.; that is stored as a region and no U.S. figure was derived.
